name: UI tests

# Runs the Appium UI tests (tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests) on an iOS simulator and an Android emulator for
# every pull request into main, after every merge into main, and on demand.
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

# A new push to a pull request cancels the run for the previous one; every merge into main is checked.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# The SDK, the workload set and Xcode the tests were last checked with. Each .NET for iOS version needs one Xcode
# version (the workload set 10.0.401.1 brings .NET for iOS 27, which needs Xcode 27), so update them together.
env:
  DOTNET_SDK_VERSION: 10.0.400
  DOTNET_WORKLOAD_VERSION: 10.0.400.1
  XCODE_VERSION: '26.6'

jobs:
  ios:
    runs-on: macos-26
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      UITEST_PLATFORM: ios
      UITEST_DEVICE: iPhone 17
      UITEST_PLATFORM_VERSION: '26.5'
      # The simulator the iOS baselines were recorded on, so the screenshots are compared too.
      UITEST_SCREENSHOTS: 'on'
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - name: Select Xcode
      run: sudo xcode-select --switch /Applications/Xcode_${{ env.XCODE_VERSION }}.app
    # The first boot of a simulator takes minutes: it boots while the next steps run.
    - name: Start booting the simulator
      run: |
        udid=$(xcrun simctl list devices available --json | jq -r \
          --arg runtime "com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimRuntime.iOS-${UITEST_PLATFORM_VERSION//./-}" --arg name "$UITEST_DEVICE" \
          '.devices[$runtime][]? | select(.name == $name) | .udid')
        if [ -z "$udid" ]; then
          echo "::error::There is no $UITEST_DEVICE simulator with iOS $UITEST_PLATFORM_VERSION on this runner."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "SIMULATOR_UDID=$udid" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        xcrun simctl boot "$udid"
    - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
      with:
        dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_SDK_VERSION }}
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
      with:
        node-version: 22
    - name: Install .NET MAUI
      run: dotnet workload install maui --version ${{ env.DOTNET_WORKLOAD_VERSION }}
    - name: Install Appium
      working-directory: tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests
      run: npm ci
    # Otherwise Appium builds it when the first test starts, which together with the boot takes longer than
    # the tests wait for the app to start.
    - name: Build WebDriverAgent
      working-directory: tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests
      env:
        APPIUM_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}/tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests
      run: npx appium driver run xcuitest build-wda --name "$UITEST_DEVICE" --sdk "$UITEST_PLATFORM_VERSION"
    - name: Build the host app
      run: dotnet build tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests.HostApp -f net10.0-ios -c Debug
    - name: Wait for the simulator
      run: xcrun simctl bootstatus "$SIMULATOR_UDID"
    - name: Run the UI tests
      run: dotnet test tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests --logger trx --logger "console;verbosity=normal"
    # Shows the results of every test in the run's summary. It writes the job summary rather than a check run,
    # so it needs no write permission and works for pull requests from forks too. The test step already fails
    # the job when a test fails.
    - name: Publish the test results
      uses: dorny/test-

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
